title: agy-auto-mode-ish Project Guardrails Policy
description: Per-project guardrails layered on top of agy-auto-mode-ish universal defaults (.agents/guardrails.json).

deny_paths.description: Workspace-relative file or directory paths (trailing slash for directories) blocked from reading and writing.

ask_write_paths.description: Workspace-relative paths where reads are auto-approved but writes/edits require explicit confirmation (force_ask).

deny_commands.description: Command regex patterns that are immediately blocked (deny).

ask_commands.description: Command regex patterns that always prompt the user for confirmation (force_ask).

allow_commands.description: Command regex patterns that are auto-approved when executed inside the workspace and no deny/ask rule matches.
